setupIntro: Complete this checklist so protection status is truthful and each permission is granted with your consent.
setupPrivacyBody: Pages are checked on your device. Only private, aggregated counts are shared.
setupAccountBody: An account is needed to register this device and manage approvals.
setupDeviceBody: The device needs a stable ID before you can request approvals.
setupPlatformBody: Android needs Accessibility access. Windows needs the protection service and a paired browser extension.
setupPlatformReady: Protection is active on this device.
setupSelfTestBody: The quick check runs on your device and never uploads page content.
setupLimitations: Standard installs add friction, not an absolute uninstall block. Device administrators keep control of the device.
